chunks: Except those who repent and come to believe and do the right. These will enter Paradise and will not be wronged the least.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for entering Paradise according to Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a promise of general salvation for the faithful, contrasting with the specific punishment for those who persist in disbelief. The triad of repentance, faith, and righteous deeds underscores the necessity of both internal conviction and external practice, a core tenet in Twelver theology. It serves as a beacon of hope, assuring that divine justice ensures no believer loses even the weight of an atom of their good deeds.
